books.title: The Secular God
books.summary: A short philosophical book that offers an accessible, non-coercive language for meeting the word God through silence, acceptance, humility, witnessing, and flow.

books.summary: A social and state model seeking synthesis between market and state, capitalism and socialism, centralization and decentralization, through civic responsibility and a stable civic floor.

books.summary: A Hebrew philosophy volume that offers a refined selection from Marcus Aurelius, Seneca, Josephus, Philo of Alexandria, Thucydides, and Nietzsche, making deep philosophical writings clearer, shorter, and more accessible while preserving each thinker’s voice.

books.title: The Civilizational Witness Scale
books.summary: A framework asking not only how much energy and power a civilization can harvest, but how consciously, responsibly, and morally it holds that power.

books.title: Foundation Book
books.summary: A Hebrew book about body, breath, posture, walking, movement, silence, and action from witnessing.
